need: A tree() species or preset for palm trees (single trunk, crown of drooping fronds) that does not fall back to azalea/oak silhouettes.
evidence: Palm trees: no tree species for palms in tree() (oak/birch/dark_oak/spruce/azalea only); hand-placed jungle logs + leaves in a palm() helper.

need: Let leaf blocks be marked intentionally free-hanging so the orphan-leaf check skips them (generalises to hanging vines, drooping foliage).
evidence: Palm fronds leave orphan leaf cells on the structure check; only persistent=true leaves are available as a closest option.

need: Roof a lower volume of a multi-level building (stepped or terrace roofs) with a preset roof, taking per-footprint eave heights rather than one eave for the whole build.
evidence: mcd roof takes one eave height; two-level house with exposed roof terrace cannot get a preset roof on the lower part; terrace deck hand-set as floor plus pane balustrade.

need: A smooth flat-membrane / smooth slate palette for flat roofs, so the flat-roof preset does not default to a grey noisy andesite/deepslate mix.
evidence: cafe preset material is a grey noisy andesite/deepslate mix that reads like a lid on a minimalist house; had to override via --spec roof.json material.mix.

need: Per-side overhang control on presets (e.g. deeper cantilever on one facing) without writing a full spec object.
evidence: cafe preset overhang fixed N2 S1 E1 W1; wanted deepest cantilever on sea side (south); kept default because the override needed a spec object.

need: A brush that places a row of slat fins or louvres as a free-standing screen with end posts, not only on an existing wall opening.
evidence: louvres works on an existing wall opening only; fins hand-placed as open birch trapdoors plus end posts.

tool: outdoor furniture brushes (lounger, parasol, fire pit)
need: Brushes for common outdoor furniture (loungers from stairs+slabs, parasol pole+disc, campfire pit) for terraces and gardens.
evidence: Sun loungers, parasol and campfire pit hand-placed with g.set; closest fixture/planter only cover lamps and window boxes.

need: A brush that builds a sealed water basin inside a coping ring (pool) without requiring stream/waterfall.
evidence: Sealed water in quartz coping ring hand-built; containWater only run by stream/waterfall; closest stream with level.

need: A frameless glass balustrade with posts (glass panes between posts, no face map needed) for terraces and balconies.
evidence: Single row of tinted panes hand-placed; railing treatment for mcd paint needs a face map; closest railing glass_pane.

need: A minimal house-number or nameplate option for minimalist walls (a dark panel with flush signs), not only a heavy shopfront board.
evidence: signboard is a heavy wall board tuned for shopfronts; house number needed a dark panel plus two hand-placed B.sign; closest plaque with 1-row band.

need: Render glass and reflective glazing with a readable tint/reflection cue so large glass walls do not read as black voids.
evidence: mcd render draws glazing near-black (interior in shade, no light engine); large glass walls read as black voids; tinted panes used as workaround.

need: Let a builder tag a palette flag as intentional (e.g. white piers on white concrete) so the trim-invisible flag is quieted without swapping blocks.
evidence: mcd palette flags white piers on white concrete as trim invisible though they read fine in shadow; swapped to smooth_quartz to quiet the flag.

need: A single-file staged build flow (form, then roof CLI step, then finish) so a roof step does not require a CLI dry run plus three scripts and a make.sh.
evidence: Staged builds need three scripts plus make.sh; roof() from library exists but instructions require CLI dry run first.

tool: daylight detector / flush placement on roof
need: Placement helper for half-height blocks (detectors, solar panels) flush against bottom-half slabs on a roof surface.
evidence: Daylight detectors could not sit in the cafe roof: slabs bottom half at y=12, detector 6/16 tall, no flush placement; left as a task.
